method: Separate whole-draft self-review against inspected source, source-pinned test logs and rendered tutorial; independent reviewers supplied the recorded specific corrections.
score_reason: Concrete evidence and scope; required audit structure and source identifiers add density. The execution record deliberately preserves historical pending states under dated checkpoints.
confidence_reason: Self-assessment with independent scoped code/reader reviews; no human style assessment.

examples.quote: Status: implementation and bounded validation complete; bounded slice complete; broad R failures classified and Julia full run incomplete. No push, merge, release or submission.
examples.impact: Lets a reviewer distinguish validated scope from broader incomplete checks

examples.quote: On Totoro, final optimized R source passed both new prior test files and the 10-file affected regression set (8.368 seconds; two existing live-Julia comparison skips). Julia final source passed its 82-check focused suite and 14 affected test files. Five live R-to-Julia fixtures passed, including same-name mu/sigma predictors, binomial partial priors, zero ridge, factor interaction and no-intercept factors. Maximum coefficient gap was 4.30e-11; maximum data-log-likelihood gap was 1.07e-12. This is bounded fixture agreement, not general parity or interval calibration.
examples.impact: Lets a reviewer distinguish validated scope from broader incomplete checks
